title: Jerusalem International Choreography Competition 2026 (11th edition)
summary: Annual choreography competition for original works (9-15 minutes, up to 4 performers) held during Jerusalem International Dance Week; cash prizes plus a guaranteed participation fee for non-winning non-Israeli entrants.
notes: Verified 2026-09-18 by direct fetch of the official call page.
